message.content: Based on the conversation, Li Hua and JakeWatson have planned multiple sessions for soccer practice. Initially, JakeWatson suggested meeting at 10 AM on Saturday, September 17th. However, Li Hua responded, "This weekend works for me! How about Saturday at 10 AM?" and JakeWatson agreed, confirming the meeting for Saturday at 10 AM. Later in November, they discussed meeting again, this time on Saturday, November 10th, at 10 AM. Therefore, Li Hua plans to meet JakeWatson for soccer practice on two occasions: first on September 17th and then again on November 10th.
